finding.title: Image/PDF filenames with Markdown delimiters lose extracted image references
finding.provenance: Local generated PNG passed through actual public Python Parser.parse_file with image).png; generated Document JSON consumed by actual Go ImageResolver.ResolveAndStore via read-only Go test overlay, using existing captureSaveBytes. No live app/data. Filename passed unchanged by parser; generated target truncates at first closing parenthesis; no matching inline ref is stored and no error is returned.
passing_commands: python -m unittest docreader.tests.test_image_filename_refs docreader.tests.test_pdf_image_sources docreader.tests.test_pdf_embedded_images docreader.tests.test_docreader_stream docreader.tests.test_source_locator_pdf docreader.tests.test_pdf_router
finding.validation: Before: real generated PNG and PDF public parser outputs consumed by Go resolver save zero images with no error for image).png/image).pdf; original JSON retained as *.before.json. Durable Python tests fail32 subcases before fix. After:94 related Python tests pass with3 pre-existing skips (5.078s), full Go docparser passes (3.235s), regenerated actual Python PNG/PDF JSON -> Go resolver overlay passes (0.574s). Shared golden references exercise12 filename categories across actual standalone PNG, scanned PDF, routed PDF, unary/stream, plus native PDF embedded figure; Go consumes same emitted-contract fixture. Empty name, Unicode/space, literal%20, #?, balanced/unbalanced parentheses, bracket/backtick, newline, backslash, HTML-like text covered. URL keys encoded once at filename entry, visible labels decoded once only; literal%20 becomes%2520 internally and Go retains exact matching. Metadata image_source_types and source_blocks agree between unary/stream. Existing ASCII names and source locations preserved. Real cloud, external Word renderers and vector-special-name end-to-end PDF are not claimed by this group.
